$comment: Instance configuration for the SOTACOMMAND engine. Copy this file to your project root as os.config.json. Engine updates never overwrite it. Keys that start with $ are ignored. Reference: skills/os-boot/references/os-config.md in the engine plugin.

shell_guard.$comment: Regular expressions matched against shell commands. deny blocks; ask needs your OK each time.

ledger.$comment: A local count of sessions, your messages (length only, never the text), refusals and failed closes, in .sotacommand/ledger.jsonl. Nothing leaves your computer. Set enabled to false to switch it off.
